resources.string: This system permission lets agentreins-moblie read and operate what\'s on any screen. agentreins-moblie uses it only on its own virtual screen to do the tasks you give it, and acts on your main screen only when you hand it a task there.
The app is now on your main screen. Tap “Done” when you\'re finished; if you\'ve already done the whole thing yourself, tap “I did it myself”.
A website sign-in is open in Settings. Tap “Done” there first, then tap “I’ll handle it”.
Couldn’t move the app to the main screen. Tap “I’ll handle it” to try again.
Couldn’t move the app back to agentreins-moblie’s screen. Try again.
If there’s no answer within %1$d min, agentreins-moblie will go on without one.
Too late: after %1$d min agentreins-moblie went on without an answer.
Unlock to see the recipient and content
